subject: Private Offer: CareLabs pilot SKU bundling & reseller margin
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@carelabs.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: partners@databridge.io
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer request for CareLabs pilot (SKU bundle + reseller margin)

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — we’re kicking off a 6–12 month pilot at CareLabs and want to move forward via a private offer on the AWS Marketplace. High level: we want a bundled SKU that covers inference units + long-term storage for model checkpoints, and we need the private offer to reflect a committed 12-month usage.

As part of procurement we also need to document how reseller margin will be handled: our reseller, DataBridge, expects an 18% commission on the net invoice. Can you confirm whether the commission is set as a marketplace pass-through line item (preferred) or if it needs to be paid outside the marketplace as a separate payout? We prefer the pass-through model if possible.

Target economics for the pilot (ballpark): 12 mo commitment, ~1.2M inference tokens/month equivalent; looking for ~25% off list price for the committed band. If 25% is not feasible when preserving reseller economics, tell us what you can do.

Attached is our procurement checklist (carelabs_po_requirements.pdf) — it lists invoice routing, tax holding, and mandatory AML/KYC fields.

Can we get a proposed pricing workbook and a suggested marketplace offer structure by EOD Friday?

Thanks,
Alice Wu
Senior Procurement Manager
CareLabs
procurement@carelabs.com

Attachment: carelabs_po_requirements.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer request for CareLabs pilot (SKU bundle + reseller margin)

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear checklist and the heads-up on DataBridge’s commission expectation. We can absolutely do a private offer for a 12-month committed band and put together a pricing workbook that lays out list price, discount bands, and how the reseller commission can be represented.

Quick notes / next steps:
- I’m looping in Jordan from Marketplace Ops to confirm whether the 18% can be handled as a pass-through line item on AWS (that’s our preference too when possible).
- Irene on Pricing will draft a proposed pricing matrix (list price, committed discount, effective net after reseller).
- Can you confirm final billing company name for invoice routing and whether CareLabs will accept a consolidated monthly invoice to your AP team? That affects how payroll/tax fields get populated.

I’ve attached a starter workbook (proposed-pricing-workbook.xlsx) — Jordan/Irene, please update with realistic SKU tiling (inference unit SKU + storage SKU + support SKU) and a channel margin column. Alice — I’ll aim to get an updated workbook to you by Friday EOD.

From: jordan.blake@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: mar cus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private Offer request for CareLabs pilot (SKU bundle + reseller margin)

Olga / Irene — quick pass on the workbook. I put together a pricing_matrix_v1.csv with line-level math (see attachment). Key points:

1) SKU tiling (recommended):
   - RED-INF-TOK: inference tokens (per-1M)
   - RED-STOR-100G: checkpoint storage (per-100GB/mo)
   - RED-PLAT-SUP: platform support (monthly recurring)

2) List prices (USD/month equivalent) and proposed committed band discounts:
   - Inference (list): $0.50 / 1M tokens
     - 12mo commit 1.2M/mo => list monthly: $600 -> 22% off => $468/mo at 22% discount; 25% off would be $450/mo.
   - Storage (list): $20 / 100GB -> for pilot (2x100GB) list $40 -> proposed 15% off => $34/mo.
   - Support: $2,000/mo list -> propose fixed $1,600/mo for pilot.

3) Reseller / channel margin handling:
   - AWS Marketplace allows a "pass-through" line item for a partner fee if configured in the private offer metadata; however, it reduces our published revenue line and can complicate tax handling. Ops feedback: pass-through with 18% is technically feasible but requires DataBridge to be a registered Marketplace partner and accept payout terms.
   - Alternative: leave the reseller commission outside the marketplace (Redwood invoices net to CareLabs, Redwood pays DataBridge separately). This keeps gross revenue on Marketplace but requires a separate reseller agreement and payout cadence.

4) Economics examples (monthly):
   - Scenario A (25% committed discount, reseller paid via pass-through 18% of net):
     - Gross list total: $600 + $40 + $2000 = $2640
     - 25% discount => $1980 net to Redwood before pass-through
     - Pass-through 18% of $1980 = $356.40 goes to DataBridge on invoice => Redwood collects $1623.60 (subject to marketplace fees/tax)

   - Scenario B (22% discount, reseller paid outside marketplace at 18% of net):
     - Gross list total: $2640
     - 22% discount => $2059.20 net to Redwood
     - DataBridge paid 18% off that net = $370.66 paid separately by Redwood -> Redwood retains $1688.54 (different tax treatment).

5) Recommendation: if CareLabs requires the reseller commission to be transparent on the invoice and wants DataBridge to see a line item, go with pass-through (Scenario A). If CareLabs prefers GDPR/tax simplicity on AP side, Scenario B is cleaner.

I added HubSpot deal note: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/13927 and a DocuSign placeholder for the PO acceptance. Also flagged a requirement from Finance: if we do pass-through, we need DataBridge to complete a W9/W8 and partner marketplace onboarding before we can finalize the private offer.

Attachment: pricing_matrix_v1.csv (csv, 12KB)

-Jordan
Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

---
Note: I also pinged Marcus for tax handling if the customer wants consolidated invoicing. Marcus — any red flags on VAT or withholding for this route?

From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@carelabs.com>

Cc: partners@databridge.io, procurement@carelabs.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer request for CareLabs pilot (SKU bundle + reseller margin)

Thanks for the rapid turnaround and the clear scenarios. A few clarifications from procurement:

- CareLabs prefers visibility: we want the reseller fee to appear on vendor invoices as a discrete line so our AP can route the payout to DataBridge’s account. If pass-through is technically feasible that aligns with our preference.
- Regarding committed discount: we can move to 22% if you can confirm that net invoice after pass-through (what Redwood receives) is at least $1,650/mo for the pilot; that gives us room for internal approvals.
- Invoice routing: CareLabs will accept a consolidated monthly invoice to AP@carelabs.com. Please include our tax ID: 94-1234567.
- Timeline: we need the finalized private offer + DocuSign PO by next Friday (2027-06-25) to keep the onboarding window open.

If you can update the workbook to show the final monthly math under a 22% discount with 18% pass-through and include a sample invoice stub showing lines and tax fields, we’ll be able to sign.

Best,
Alice Wu
Senior Procurement Manager
CareLabs
procurement@carelabs.com

Alice — I’ll target to have the updated workbook + invoice stub by Tue EOD (2027-06-22) so you have time for internal approvals before the 25th. If DataBridge needs to complete onboarding paperwork, Jordan will loop them directly.

Talk soon,
Olga
Head of Marketplace Sales
